title: Movers, tree services, and haulers business-contact review
hypothesis: An active FMCSA carrier row can establish a published business contact and a role-labeled identity candidate for a narrowly matched mover, truck-equipped tree-service, junk-removal, or hauling business. It does not establish that a local business is FMCSA-covered, that Company Officer 1 is the current owner, that the published number belongs to that person, or that the number is mobile, live, DNC-cleared, or deliverable.
ownerSource: FMCSA Company Officer 1 is an officer/identity candidate only. Legal name matching that person's name is a sole-proprietor signal only after entity-type consistency is checked; a corporate officer is never owner-confirmed from this register alone.
phoneSource: FMCSA `cell_phone` when published, otherwise `phone`; both are published carrier/business-contact candidates until independent line-type, live, DNC, suppression, dedupe, and owner/handset evidence exists.

workflow.label: Read active FMCSA carrier row
workflow.detail: Use the implemented active-state segments from az4n-8mr2. The carrier census covers USDOT-reporting carriers, not every local mover, tree service, junk remover, or hauler.

workflow.label: Specific service and carrier fit?
workflow.detail: Require household-goods cargo for movers, or an explicit tree, junk, hauling, or equivalent service signal. Hold towing, machinery, freight, private-property, landscaping-only, and generic transport rows unless a separately scoped workflow admits them.

workflow.label: Hold adjacent or ambiguous carrier
workflow.detail: Do not turn cargo flags, a truck, or a broad name match into a mover, tree-service, or hauling classification.

workflow.label: Small-carrier segment?
workflow.detail: For the current micro-business hypothesis, require a known power-unit count of three or fewer; missing or larger fleets remain business candidates outside this owner-candidate segment.

workflow.label: Hold missing or larger fleet
workflow.detail: Keep the row from the micro-owner branch; do not infer scale from a title or phone.

workflow.label: Assess officer and entity evidence
workflow.detail: Retain Company Officer 1 with its entity type and legal-name comparison. An Individual row with a matching person may be a stronger candidate; an officer, corporation, partnership, or blank entity type is not owner confirmation.

workflow.label: Hold unsupported owner claim
workflow.detail: Keep officer identity provenance but do not label the person an owner or use any address to discover a private number.

workflow.label: Published carrier phone present?
workflow.detail: Use the published `cell_phone` preference or `phone` as business-contact evidence only; cell-field presence does not prove handset ownership.

workflow.label: Hold without eligible contact
workflow.detail: Do not infer, append, or derive a private contact from carrier, officer, or address fields.

workflow.label: Apply contact and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require the existing independent line-type, live, DNC, suppression, and global delivery-dedupe checks; preserve source and role provenance.

workflow.label: Independent owner and handset evidence?
workflow.detail: An FMCSA officer, legal-name match, or a published carrier phone alone is insufficient for an owner-confirmed mobile.

workflow.label: Hold as business contact or owner candidate
workflow.detail: Retain only the classification supported by evidence; no owner-confirmed mobile is emitted.

workflow.label: Deliver approved owner-confirmed contact
workflow.detail: Only a future route with independently recorded owner and handset evidence plus all contact gates may deliver this classification.

edges.label: line, live, DNC, suppression, or dedupe failed

failures.risk: A local business is excluded or represented as eligible merely because it is absent from or present in FMCSA.
failures.mitigation: Describe FMCSA as a USDOT-carrier source only; retain a separately reviewed business-listing or local-register path for non-covered businesses and never use census presence as a license or universal-coverage claim.

failures.risk: A mover, tree service, or hauler route admits towing, freight, machinery, private-property, landscaping-only, or generic transport businesses.
failures.mitigation: Require an explicit service branch and hold adjacent/ambiguous rows before owner-candidate processing.

failures.risk: A Company Officer 1 name or legal-name equality is labeled as the owner or as a sole proprietor when the carrier is a corporation.
failures.mitigation: Persist entity type and role provenance; require `INDIVIDUAL` consistency before the sole-proprietor signal and independently corroborate ownership in every other case.

failures.risk: A published carrier phone, including `cell_phone`, is labeled as the officer's direct mobile.
failures.mitigation: Keep the line business-contact evidence until independent line-type, live, DNC, suppression, dedupe, owner, and handset-evidence gates pass.

failures.risk: Large fleets enter the one-to-three-power-unit micro-business hypothesis.
failures.mitigation: Apply the documented `power_units <= 3` branch before owner-candidate scoring and hold missing or larger values.

iterations.hypothesis: A legal-name equals Company Officer 1 match safely identifies a sole proprietor for the FMCSA owner-candidate branch.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24: parsed the first five saved active FMCSA rows through `fmcsa` with the same adapter cursor used by the focused test. Command: `node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e ...`; no network, credential, paid call, contact export, private lookup, line verification, or delivery ran.
iterations.observed: 5/5 rows parsed to a person candidate; 4/5 retained a published non-toll-free phone; 5/5 were marked Sole Proprietor because legal name equaled officer name; 2/5 of those Sole Proprietor labels had `business_org_desc = CORPORATION`. This is fixture/parser behavior only, not ownership, handset, line-type, reachability, DNC, or delivery evidence.
iterations.change: Do not use legal-name equality alone as sole-proprietor or owner proof. Root should require entity-type consistency for the Sole Proprietor label, retain Company Officer 1 as role evidence otherwise, and add the two corporate-match fixture cases as regressions.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: FMCSA now requires business_org_desc=INDIVIDUAL as well as legal/officer-name equality before setting Sole Proprietor. Corporations, partnerships and missing entity types remain role candidates. Independent owner proof and service-specific fleet filtering are still pending.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five saved active FMCSA fixture rows: person candidate 5/5; non-toll-free published phone retained 4/5; parser Sole Proprietor label 5/5; corporation rows incorrectly carrying that label 2/5. Local fixture/code audit only. No live query, paid/provider call, ownership confirmation, mobile classification, reachability, DNC check, private lookup, or delivery occurred.

cost.basis: Local fixture/code audit; no paid or live verification
cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. The movers_tree_haulers brain estimates are not a per-clean cost and use no verified-phone sample.

implementation.summary: FMCSA now requires business_org_desc=INDIVIDUAL as well as legal/officer-name equality before setting Sole Proprietor. Corporations, partnerships and missing entity types remain role candidates. Independent owner proof and service-specific fleet filtering are still pending. Original review: The live brain maps this industry to FMCSA and the adapter uses active state-by-filter segments, preserves a Company Officer 1 candidate, prefers `cell_phone`, and drops toll-free numbers. The adapter does not enforce the brain's power-unit threshold or a narrow service classification, and it currently derives Sole Proprietor solely from legal/officer equality, including corporation rows.

nextMeasurement: After root corrects the FMCSA role classification, add synthetic Individual-match, Corporation-match, blank-entity, over-three-power-unit, towing/freight, and explicit mover/tree/hauling cases. Verify that only eligible service and small-carrier candidates reach contact gates, corporate officers remain candidate-only, and no owner-confirmed mobile is emitted without independent evidence. A separately authorized live study must measure coverage by subvertical, phone line type, DNC, reachability, reached owner, and delivery with separate denominators.
